provenance.header_note: Header reads "Part – III PHYSICS, Paper-I (English Version)"; booklet code 119/TS (Day-9), set A. Total questions 21, printed pages 2.

questions.text: What is Physics?
Distinguish between fundamental units and derived units.
If P = 2i + 4j + 14k and Q = 4i + 4j + 10k, find the magnitude of P + Q.
If a bomb at rest explodes into two pieces, the pieces must travel in opposite directions. Explain.
What is magnus effect?
Give the expression for the excess pressure in a soap bubble.
What are the lower and upper fixing points in Celsius and Fahrenheit scales?
What is thermal expansion?
When does a real gas behave like an ideal gas?
State the law of equipartition of energy.
A car travels the first third of a distance with a speed of 10 kmph, the second third at 20 kmph and the last third at 60 kmph. What is its mean speed over the entire distance?
Derive an expression for the magnitude and direction of the resultant vector using parallelogram law.
Mention the methods used to decrease friction.
Distinguish between centre of mass and centre of gravity.
Define angular velocity (ω). Derive v = rω.
What is escape velocity? Obtain an expression for it.
Define stress and explain the types of stress.
Explain conduction, convection and radiation with examples.

State and prove law of conservation of energy in case of a freely falling body. A pump is required to lift 600 kg of water per minute from a well of 25 m deep and to eject it with a speed of 50 ms⁻¹. Calculate the power required to perform the above task. (g = 10 ms⁻²)
